What used to be "it breaks when I click here" over three Slack messages becomes one link your agent reads end to end. [...] AREC states its capture gaps explicitly, so the agent can say what it does not know.

### Reproduce and fix a bug

Public link or MCP

The job this category was invented for. The recording carries the exact element and the click, so the agent stops guessing which button you meant.

 “Turn this recording into reproduction steps, then find the code responsible: ”

  Narration gives intent, key-moment frames give the screen state.
 “I clicked something that did nothing. Read the recording, identify the exact control from the click target, and trace its handler.”

  Click coordinates come from Mac-app and Chrome-extension captures.
